description: Scenario: newsreader client uses NEWNEWS to retrieve message-IDs of articles posted since its last connection (RFC 3977 §7.4). session/commands/list.rs::newnews unconditionally returns an empty 230 response. Consequence: any client relying on NEWNEWS for incremental article sync (slrn uses this, as do suck/leafnode pull feeds) will never receive article notifications. The server will silently appear empty to these clients regardless of how many articles have been posted.
title: NEWNEWS always returns empty — incremental sync broken
